issue.body:
Currently the documentation on using the AuthenticationMiddleware doesn't indicate how to change the default error_handler used. 

I would suggest either updating the docs to ensure that the `on_error` parameter can be passed into the middleware invocation i.e. `app.add_middleware(AuthenticationMiddleware, backend=backends.AgentAuthBackend(), on_error=default_on_error)` or getting the `default_on_error` used by the AuthenticationMiddleware respect the application exception_handler
issue.title: Changing error handler when using the AuthenticationMiddleware
